revision_lessons: Round 1: [high] task_fit - Retry with stricter prompting for two separate props only: a lantern and a clearly visible basket filled with mushrooms, with no characters or dolls.
Round 1: [high] visual_defect - Retry with blank button labels or clean post-processed placeholder text added outside generation. Avoid relying on image model text rendering.
Round 1: [high] visual_defect - Retry with empty label areas only, then add final text in post. Keep button shapes and decoration, but remove generated lettering.
Round 1: [medium] asset_consistency - Retry with the same centered, isolated icon treatment as icons_1 and without any checkerboard or faux transparency background.
Round 1: [medium] style_consistency - Consider a retry or revision toward simpler silhouettes, larger readable forms, and reduced rendering detail to better match characters_1.
Round 1: [medium] task_fit - Retry with simpler planes, less atmospheric detail, and a more game-asset-oriented composition focused on the ancient tree as the main reusable element.
Round 1: [low] task_fit - Optional retry for flatter lighting, cleaner silhouette separation, and less scene-like framing if the asset is intended for direct in-game placement.
Round 1: [low] style_consistency - Either simplify characters_2 to match this style or regenerate characters_1 with slightly less exaggerated proportions for better character set cohesion.
Round 2: [medium] task_fit - Retry with stricter isolated asset framing, flatter background treatment or transparent background, reduced vignette, and stronger silhouette readability.

Round 2: [medium] asset_consistency - Retry to align body proportions, facial treatment, and rendering density with the other character asset or revise both characters toward one unified style target.
Round 2: [low] task_fit - Acceptable if the pack allows illustrative assets; otherwise retry with simpler ground treatment and cleaner cutout-friendly presentation.
Round 2: [medium] asset_consistency - Retry to simplify into a more modular environment asset or rebalance both environment pieces to the same level of scene complexity and camera treatment.
Round 2: [high] story_coherence - Retry immediately with explicit emphasis on mushrooms only, no characters, no faces, and clear prop-only composition.
Round 2: [medium] asset_consistency - Retry with neutral scale, cleaner spacing, and less atmospheric backdrop so the props read as modular game assets.
Round 2: [low] visual_defect - Consider a light revision to improve sign readability and balance detail density across the object.
Round 2: [medium] task_fit - Retry with crisper edges, reduced bloom, flatter values, and more standardized icon silhouettes.
Round 2: [medium] asset_consistency - Retry both icon sheets or this asset to enforce a unified icon grid, equal scale, consistent stroke/contrast, and matching semantic grouping.
Round 2: [low] task_fit - Minor revision only: simplify corner ornamentation and ensure inner text area margins are generous.
Round 2: [medium] asset_consistency - Revise to better match ui_elements_1 in motif density, border thickness, and component proportions.
Round 3: [medium] asset_consistency - Retry with simpler shapes, slightly chibi-proportioned readability, softer detailing, and silhouette language closer to characters_1.
Round 3: [low] visual_defect - Retry or postprocess to remove the heavy background glow/vignette and keep the figure isolated on a cleaner neutral or transparent presentation.
Round 3: [medium] asset_consistency - Retry with stronger moonlit violet ambience, cooler shadow treatment, and reduced golden dominance while preserving warm lantern accents.
Round 3: [medium] task_fit - Retry with a wider scene composition, more navigable ground plane, and less floating diorama presentation to better match game environment usage.
Round 3: [medium] story_coherence - Retry without embedded text and emphasize carved symbolic wayfinding plus a clearly separate hanging herb bundle.
Round 3: [medium] task_fit - Retry with flatter, simpler icon abstraction, stronger silhouette reduction, and clearer equal-weight pairing with the herb symbol.
Round 3: [low] asset_consistency - Adjust toward more moonlit violet, moss green, and lantern-gold balance, with less dominant red for tighter pack cohesion.
Round 3: [low] task_fit - Consider a retry or alternate version in a wider horizontal layout better suited for dialogue text boxes.

critique.summary: Strong, cohesive 2D fantasy asset pack with complete category coverage and generally consistent moonlit woodland styling. Composition is clean and readable, and most assets are production-usable. Main weaknesses are inconsistent rendering treatment across characters and environments, some prompt drift in icon/story specificity, and a few UI/text decisions that reduce system consistency. No critical defects, but several assets would benefit from targeted retries for tighter pack cohesion.

issues.message: The herbalist is rendered with noticeably more detailed, polished illustration treatment than the villager, creating a style gap within the character set.
issues.recommendation: Retry with simpler shapes, slightly chibi-proportioned readability, softer detailing, and silhouette language closer to characters_1.

issues.message: The character sits on a dark vignetted backdrop rather than feeling fully transparent-background friendly, which reduces consistency with other isolated assets.
issues.recommendation: Retry or postprocess to remove the heavy background glow/vignette and keep the figure isolated on a cleaner neutral or transparent presentation.

issues.message: The cottage exterior is more warm, bright, and storybook-daylit than moonlit, making it less aligned with the pack's stated moonlit violet palette.
issues.recommendation: Retry with stronger moonlit violet ambience, cooler shadow treatment, and reduced golden dominance while preserving warm lantern accents.

issues.message: The clearing reads as a decorative diorama/island rather than a reusable environment asset or broader scene backdrop.
issues.recommendation: Retry with a wider scene composition, more navigable ground plane, and less floating diorama presentation to better match game environment usage.

issues.message: The sign includes the word 'Herbs,' introducing baked-in text and changing the requested object from a signpost with hanging herb bundle into a labeled shop-style prop.
issues.recommendation: Retry without embedded text and emphasize carved symbolic wayfinding plus a clearly separate hanging herb bundle.

issues.message: The trail marker icon is rendered as a fairly detailed wooden signpost prop, which reads more like scene art than a compact UI icon.
issues.recommendation: Retry with flatter, simpler icon abstraction, stronger silhouette reduction, and clearer equal-weight pairing with the herb symbol.

issues.message: The health bar and buttons lean toward high-saturation red and polished fantasy UI styling, which is slightly louder than the calmer moonlit woodland palette used elsewhere.
issues.recommendation: Adjust toward more moonlit violet, moss green, and lantern-gold balance, with less dominant red for tighter pack cohesion.

issues.message: The dialogue frame is attractive but very tall and portrait-oriented, which is less practical for standard in-game dialogue presentation.
issues.recommendation: Consider a retry or alternate version in a wider horizontal layout better suited for dialogue text boxes.

revision.rationale: Round 3 still has several medium-severity cohesion and task-fit issues, but the overall pack passed quality threshold and should not be globally rejected. Use the remaining revision budget selectively on the assets that most affect consistency and usability, while leaving low-severity items for postprocess or acceptance.
